assets.label: Storm Runner — identité, deux orientations
assets.prompt:
Generate an ORIGINAL new design proposal for the 2D Yautja fan-game La Longue Chasse, based on a requested name with only partial or no precise visual specification. This is NOT a canonical film replica. Exactly TWO complete SIDE profiles SIDE BY SIDE: left view facing RIGHT, right view facing LEFT, independently draw the same construction/anatomy in opposite orientations and identical scale. Entire silhouettes must fit in the central 80 percent of each half with generous blank outer and central margins. Pure uniform MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Detailed hand-painted bitmap, no ground shadow, scenery, text, watermarks, diagram labels or grid. No human, Yautja rider, passengers, cargo, trophies, UI or effects. Bare animal layer: no saddle, tack or armor. Original fast plains alien mount PROPOSAL with exactly FOUR long springy digitigrade limbs, lean deep-chested body, narrow forward head with aerodynamic backward bony crests, long balancing tail, smooth blue-grey mottled hide and small dark dorsal fins. Broad three-clawed toes, clear correctly connected joints. No lightning bolts or glowing electricity, no saddle. Alert standing neutral pose, not a running animation.
Production correction: use a strict flat orthographic side-view camera with zero three-quarter perspective. Exactly two independently authored opposing side profiles in one horizontal row. Preserve a wide empty magenta gutter and at least 10 percent blank margin around each complete silhouette. Every requested removable module must stay absent, closed, folded, stowed, or represented only by an empty hardpoint exactly as specified.

references.role: Recovered user request normalized as an explicit original design proposal

notes: OpenAI ImageGen original identity proposal; no canonical appearance is asserted.

Visually inspected: each opposing profile has exactly four long connected digitigrade legs and four complete three-clawed feet, with full tail and crest in frame; neutral standing pose, no electrical effect, saddle or rider.
Static bare-animal review sheet only; no gameplay, rig or animation acceptance implied. Runtime transparency is applied by the production review renderer.
